battle_versatility.description: The hero in the middle of a battle, whirling between foes, striking with the flail while blocking a blow and hurling a bolt of red energy at a distant enemy, sparks and red battle haze.

cold_toughness.description: The hero standing firm in a snowstorm, shrugging off a blast of ice with a raised gauntlet, frost and icicles forming on his armor, cold blue light.

concentration.description: A focused sorcerer with eyes closed, fingertips touching temples, three small orbs of blue, white and red mana orbiting the head, calm green aura, dark background.

crystal_joy.description: The hero laughing joyfully as glowing crystals of red, blue, white and green spill and float from his hands, playful sparkles, cool blue magical light in a crystal cave.

crystallize.description: Hands holding swirling blue mana energy that condenses into a glowing faceted blue crystal, sparkles and light refractions, dark mystic background.

determination.description: A steadfast armored knight standing firm behind a raised shield, jaw set, deep blue light glowing around him, enemies looming in a stormy background.

improvisation.description: A resourceful warrior catching a sword and a torch mid-air while a card-like scroll burns away in red flames, energetic red-orange background, dynamic pose.

instinct.description: The hero crouching and turning instantly to face a sudden ambush in a dark forest, sword swinging up, tense atmosphere, red and amber light.

mana_draw.description: A mage reaching up toward a radiant white source of light in the sky, ribbons of colored magical energy flowing down into an open palm, white luminous background.

mana_pull.description: The hero pulling a stream of black and violet mana out of a swirling dark void with an outstretched hand, white sparks crackling, ominous night sky.

march.description: A lone traveller in a hooded green cloak striding briskly along a winding road through green hills and forest at dawn, walking staff in hand, sense of speed and determination, soft green light.

noble_manners.description: The hero bowing gracefully before a delighted crowd of nobles and townsfolk in a sunlit hall, courtly elegance, soft white and gold light.

promise.description: A charismatic noble in white and gold clothing offering a handshake to a hesitant villager, warm golden light, a village square in the background.

rage.description: A muscular bare-chested warrior screaming in uncontrolled battle fury, veins standing out, an aura of red and orange flames of anger around him, dark smoky background lit in red.

rejuvenate.description: The hero in a forest glade with arms spread, vines and blossoms blooming around, wounded soldiers getting up refreshed, glowing green healing motes.

stamina.description: A tireless traveller in a blue cloak climbing a steep rocky mountain path with a heavy pack, determined expression, cool blue twilight light, distant peaks.

swiftness.description: A nimble archer in a white and silver tunic leaping lightly through the air while loosing an arrow, motion streaks of white wind trailing behind, bright sky.

threaten.description: A menacing armored warrior looming over cowering townsfolk, pointing a blade at them, harsh red light and dark shadows, intimidating posture.

tranquility.description: A serene figure meditating cross-legged beside a calm forest pond, soft green glow, floating leaves and fireflies, peaceful misty trees.

will_focus.description: The hero channeling intense green magical energy into a glowing green crystal held between both clawed hands, concentric rings of light, emerald glow, ancient stone ruins.

wound.description: A single large, glossy drop of dark red blood, centered, on a plain dark muted grey-brown background, simple and bold, nothing else.
